reviews.x: I have been on a patchouli kick recently and I love this body butter! The  consistency is wonderful. It's nice and rich and it makes my skin feel great! To top it off the scent of patchouli is very aromatherapeutic. It makes ME feel great. The company provided a sample lotion with the order which I fell in love with and ordered immediately! Mountain Country Soap, you're making some awesome products 👏

The scent was a perfect balance, non-greasy, very moisturizing.  I have extremely sensitive skin and have had no problems at all.  Patchouli is my go-to scent that I have worn for over twenty years.  This product is absolutely true to the fragrance.  Put it on, and you will quickly notice just how true to the fragrance it is.  Excellent product, my new favorite brand for body items (soap, lotion etc.)

reviews.t: If you love Patchouli, you'll love this!
reviews.x: This scent is spot on if you are looking for that earthy patchouli smell. It's creamy texture goes on smooth and silky but not too silky, I don't care for a body butter that is too thin and this is just right. The smell is exactly like I wanted, very clean smelling. And a nice little surprise that they include samples of their other products. Will definitely buy again!

I’ve purchased this wonderful body butter 3 times in past year and will continue to use in my daily ritual. The scent actually smells like the plant and it is so thick and luxurious. If you’re tired of thin runny lotions and patchouli that doesn’t smell natural you have to try Aging Hippie body butter!!!  Wonderful amazing product. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.t: Strong and Musky, Not Like Any Oils I Used In the 60s.
reviews.x: This scent was horrible.  The patchouli was so strong and musky.  And whatever else is in this caused my lips to tingle and throat to close up. I only put some from the lid on my hands and my body absorbed whatever oils are in it.  It is nothing like I ever wore in the 60s.  I have worn patchouli oil since then and never did my oils smell this strong or musky.  This would probably work for a repellent but not as a relaxing feminine fragrance.  Moisturizing did seem to be good so I added a star.
I highly recommend this body butter for anyone with really dry skin who absolutely loves the smell of Patchouli.  It's very rich and creamy, and highly aromatic.

reviews.t: I truly do love this product!
reviews.x: I would give it 5 stars but it has a slight, and I say very slight, hint of plastic (like a new toy) to it when you first apply it.  Now!  Don’t let this deter you, as it fades as it wears and the patchouli comes out. This butter leaves you with that all over glow, it’s nice and hydrating but not a greasy as most butters.  I’ve tried so many patchouli butters and this is overall the best one that I can find.  Super nice product.  I’d buy it if I were you!

The body butter itself is great.  It is a light whipped texture that absorbs into your skin easily without being greasy.  I would like to note to other potential buyers, that I am a huge fan of herbal scents but that if you aren't - this may not be the best scent for you.  The patchouli offers a bit of a medicinal vibe in this body butter.  So much so that I am mindful of where I am headed before applying this body butter.  I can see it being offensive to others. I love this stuff!  Their patchouli aroma is the best!  Sad because they no longer offer the body wash.  Highly recommend this product!!!

The product scent didn’t really last for any length of time and the scent smelled better once it was on the skin for a short time ... the moisturizing aspect was ok ... I was disappointed as the reviews were very favorable ....

reviews.t: Has your mom ever asked you for a rubber bath mat? Mine neither.
reviews.x: I tried to order some patchouli body butter for my mom’s birthday and instead these artisan soap makers sent her a rubber bathmat, and I have now been ridiculed in our trash community.
I put this on hours ago and the scent of patchouli is ongoing. Which I love! It is a lighter whipped body cream that isn’t heavily oily. Great for normal to lightly dry skin.
I get complimented all the time on the sent of this lotion. The only one I have found with a scent that lasts a long time. Later with oil and lasts even longer.
Just to say... This product is excellent and I will continue to reorder. Leave skin very moist and the aroma lasts which I appreciate. Thank you for this. RG
This body butter is soft and smooth, however, the smell is terrible.  I am so disappointed,  I was really looking forward to some good patchouli lotion.
This special sweet cream was a Mother’s Day gift. Mom loved it! Said it smelled great. Super hippie chick Patchouli realness.

claims.text: Most reviewers love the patchouli scent, describing it as authentic, earthy, and true to the fragrance.
Reviewers frequently praise the rich, creamy, moisturizing texture that absorbs well without being greasy.
A few reviewers strongly disliked the scent, calling it too strong, musky, or not like patchouli.
Some reviewers mention receiving a free sample with their order as a nice surprise.
A couple of reviewers note issues like a slight plastic hint or a recent order arriving unscented and runny.
